title: Fix WordInfoModal infinite re-render crash
description: Clicking the info button on a lyric line causes an infinite re-render loop that crashes React and shows 404. Root cause: lineAudioSnippets array is recreated on every render in WordInfoModal, triggering useAudioPreloader's useEffect in an infinite loop. The fix is to memoize the lineAudioSnippets array with useMemo.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Memoize lineAudioSnippets array in WordInfoModal using useMemo with proper dependencies
Clicking info button opens modal without crashing
Line audio playback controls work in modal
No 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors in console
